statement: ∀ (A B C : Set ℤ), A ∩ (B ∪ C) = (A ∩ B) ∪ (A ∩ C)
proofTerm:
by
  intro A B C
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rcases hx with ⟨hxA, hxBUC⟩
    rcases hxBUC with hxB | hxC
    · left
      exact ⟨hxA, hxB⟩
    · right
      exact ⟨hxA, hxC⟩
  · intro hx
    rcases hx with hxAB | hxAC
    · rcases hxAB with ⟨hxA, hxB⟩
      exact ⟨hxA, Or.inl hxB⟩
    · rcases hxAC with ⟨hxA, hxC⟩
      exact ⟨hxA, Or.inr hxC⟩

sourceSteps.sourceExcerpt: 取任意整数 x。若 x∈A∩(B∪C)，则 x∈A 且 x∈B∪C。
sourceSteps.leanWitness: intro A B C; ext x; constructor; · intro hx; rcases hx with ⟨hxA, hxBUC⟩

sourceSteps.sourceExcerpt: 若 x∈B，便有 x∈A∩B；若 x∈C，便有 x∈A∩C。
sourceSteps.leanWitness: rcases hxBUC with hxB | hxC; · left; exact ⟨hxA, hxB⟩; · right; exact ⟨hxA, hxC⟩
left; exact ⟨hxA, hxB⟩（第一分支）与 right; exact ⟨hxA, hxC⟩（第二分支）构造并集成员关系

sourceSteps.sourceExcerpt: 反之若 x∈(A∩B)∪(A∩C)，则分两种情形：x∈A∩B 或 x∈A∩C。
sourceSteps.leanWitness: · intro hx; rcases hx with hxAB | hxAC

sourceSteps.sourceExcerpt: 不管哪一种，都有 x∈A，并有 x∈B 或 x∈C，从而 x∈A∩(B∪C)。
sourceSteps.leanWitness: · rcases hxAB with ⟨hxA, hxB⟩; exact ⟨hxA, Or.inl hxB⟩; · rcases hxAC with ⟨hxA, hxC⟩; exact ⟨hxA, Or.inr hxC⟩

sourceSteps.sourceExcerpt: 由集合外延性，两边相等。证毕。
sourceSteps.leanWitness: ext x; constructor（用集合外延性化为双向成员关系，并在两分支完成后闭合等式）
